thread:
alex: heads up — noticed role change audit missing actor on prod. change: role 'data-reader' added to service-account svc-ml. logs show auth_event with actor=null. Anyone seen this?
maria-g: @alex can you paste the log line?
alex: ```json
{ \"event\": \"role.update\", \"target\": \"svc-ml\", \"role\": \"data-reader\", \"actor\": null, \"time\": \"2026-03-18T12:34:56Z\" }
```
samir: Oof. Could be from KMS rotation job or the migration script running as system. Check the scheduler credentials.
josh: I queried infra-audit index: `search index=infra-audit event=role.update target=svc-ml | sort -desc time` — only one entry, actor null. No matching API key usage in api-keys logs.
alex: Is this a data exfil risk? compliance needs an explanation for the upcoming audit.
maria-g: Assigning to oncall: @pete can you triage? Also file a ticket in SecurOps. We need timeline + root cause + list of affected principals.
pete: on it. First steps: 1) repro with staging? 2) check KMS decrypt logs 3) check perm-sync service account creds 4) pull kubernetes controller logs. Posting initial findings in 15m.
sec-bot: Incident created: S-2026-0318-01 — priority P2 — tagged rbac,audit-logs
samir: Possible hypothesis: historical perm-sync used internal 'system' actor and we recently changed auth adapter to OIDC and dropped actor header. Also note: if service uses KMS-wrapped tokens they may not map to users.
maria-g: For compliance: collect all role.update events with null actor since 2026-01-01, export to csv and provide to compliance@redwood.com.
alex: I'll run the search: `curl -s https://elk/_search -d '{"query":{"bool":{"must":[{"term":{"event":"role.update"}},{"term":{"actor":null}}]}}}' | jq '.'` — running now.
pete: FYI found controller log showing 2026-03-18T12:34:55Z "perm-sync applying delta" run by service account "perm-sync@infra" — but in audit it shows actor null. Hypothesis: perm-sync used server-side impersonation header "X-Actor" and we dropped it at the ingress LB. Checking load balancer logs.
maria-g: Good. Next: update perm-sync to set 'audit_actor' in payload until LB fix. Also escalate to infra for LB header pass-through. cc @infra-team.
alex: tagging compliance: @compliance Help — we likely need a statement for auditors, will prepare provisional timeline.
compliance-bot: Received S-2026-0318-01. Please submit 1) exported events, 2) mitigation plan, 3) affected workloads list.
josh: Adding: add a permanent log-enrichment patch to ensure actor identity string is always set, and add unit tests.
alex: Thanks all. We'll sync in 30 minutes in #eng-security. :thumbsup:
